verdict.rationale: Codex supports sign-in tied to ChatGPT Business/Edu/Enterprise plans and OpenAI's platform offers RBAC for organization/project-level access control, suggesting some enterprise identity and governance support. However there is no explicit evidence of SSO/SAML/OIDC federation with enterprise IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, etc.) or compliance certifications tied to authentication. Missing for 10: explicit SSO/SAML/OIDC enterprise identity provider integration, documented compliance certifications (SOC2/HIPAA) tied to auth, and independent confirmation of enterprise auth working at scale.
